title: The county landfill under a flea market
subtitle: Forty years of leaking leachate, and three lawsuits
source: Community Impact, from Travis County records
alt: Timeline of Travis County's closed landfill on East US 290, as reported by Community Impact: the county ran it from 1968 to 1982; the Austin Country Flea Market opened on the property in 1986; the state sued the county in May 2025 and the landowner sued in July 2025; the county sued to take the property in December 2025; commissioners approved up to $5.65 million on October 6, 2026; a federal jury trial is set for June 2027.

events.label: Flea market opens on the property
events.note: About 21 acres sit on top of the landfill

events.label: Three lawsuits
events.note: The state in May, the landowner in July, the county to take the land in December
